mechanism: Foscarnet can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate CNS depression from methocarbamol and impair renal clearance of both agents.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and signs of excessive CNS depression; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy and consider dose adjustments based on creatinine clearance.
